resource_scope: Original build-a RouteOptimize; final implementation inherited unchanged cells/placements through documented hold-route and reset changes
board_measurement_scope: 1280x720 effective camera processing; 435 accepted/processed/newly-presented frames in 29 counter seconds = 15 fps; configured 1920x1080p30 HDMI raster, refresh not independently measured by UART
limits: Original absolute paths preserved; portable rebuild not performed.
Original RouteOptimize resources are bound to final bit through function/placement-preserving changes, not newly remeasured.
Board UART underflow counters unavailable; cannot claim proven fault-free operation.

verification_dependencies.runtime: Python 3 standard library only; no Git, PDS, root distortion/tools, UART or JTAG required.
verification_dependencies.verify_selected: Uses only files within delivery/20261104-camera720p15: source-manifest.json, reports-manifest.json, their listed files, identity.json, the selected bitstream and audit.json.
verification_dependencies.verify_bundle: Uses only its own original archive directory; the sibling summary JSON is required only when --summary is supplied.

historical_rebuild_dependencies.purpose: Historical build, board diagnostics and analysis utilities; not required by either integrity verifier.
historical_rebuild_dependencies.frozen_production_inputs: source/compiled/ and source/timing.tcl; original upstream inputs in source/upstream/
historical_rebuild_dependencies.toolchain: External licensed PDS 2023.2-SP3 (build 154097), device/IP installation; executable identity is recorded in source-manifest.json.
historical_rebuild_dependencies.note: Original scripts retain historical absolute paths and may reference other historical utilities. A fresh rebuild requires relocation and dependency review; absence of the entire root distortion/tools directory from the two-version delivery package does not make its source or evidence integrity verification incomplete.
